meta.register: BD-Adresses (geocoded addresses of the Registre national des localités et des rues, CACLR)
meta.publisher: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT)
meta.attribution: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie, BD-Adresses, data.public.lu
meta.notes: every row kept, the register has no status or placement flag; id is id_caclr_bat, the CACLR address id; point is the register's own WGS84 columns (they agree with its LUREF EPSG:2169 columns through pyproj to 1e-7 degrees); localite is the city, postcode as written without the L- prefix
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:4326: axis order change (2D) + Null geographic offset from WGS 84 to WGS 84 + axis order change (2D)
